gloss: to develop an illness; to fall ill

definitions.gloss: to develop an illness; to fall ill
definitions.explanation: For symptoms of a disease to appear or manifest; to come down with an illness.

examples.japanese: {感染|かんせん}してから{発病|はつびょう}するまで{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time from infection to developing symptoms.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は60{歳|さい}のときに{発病|はつびょう}した。
examples.english: My grandfather developed the illness when he was 60.

examples.japanese: ストレスが{原因|げんいん}で{発病|はつびょう}するケースも{少|すく}なくない。
examples.english: Cases where the illness develops due to stress are not uncommon.

notes:
A compound of {発|はつ} (occurrence/onset) and {病|びょう} (illness). Focuses on the moment when a disease first manifests symptoms, rather than the ongoing state of being sick. Often used in medical contexts and news reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発病|はつびょう}する{前|まえ} — before developing the illness
- {発病|はつびょう}のリスク — risk of developing the disease
- {発病|はつびょう}{年齢|ねんれい} — age of onset
- {急|きゅう}に{発病|はつびょう}する — to develop the illness suddenly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {発症|はっしょう}する — to develop symptoms (very close synonym; {発症|はっしょう} is more common in modern medical writing)
- {病気|びょうき}になる — to get sick (everyday/general expression, less clinical)
- {罹患|りかん}する — to be affected by a disease (formal/medical; emphasizes contracting rather than symptom onset)
